close_reason: Fixed: changed >= to > in read_line; parse_smtp_line kept at >= for synthetic callers. All 25 relay_client tests pass.
description: relay_client.rs:669 and parse_smtp_line:711 check line.len() >= MAX_SMTP_LINE (512). RFC 5321 §4.5.3.1.5: reply line limit is 512 bytes including CRLF. BufReader::read_line includes the trailing newline, so a 512-byte reply (510 data + CRLF) gives len=512 and is incorrectly rejected. Should be > 512. The test 'parse_smtp_line_exactly_512_bytes_is_rejected' encodes the bug as expected behavior.
title: relay_client MAX_SMTP_LINE: >= 512 rejects valid 512-byte RFC 5321 reply lines
